subject: Trial check-in: stakeholder lanes + action grid for POC success
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: John Miller <jm@olivelabs.com>, Olive Labs POC <poc@olivelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Trial check-in: stakeholder lanes + action grid for POC success

Hi John / team —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed action grid so we can lock the 6-week trial timeline and make sure responsibilities are clear:

Why the trial (agreed success criteria)
- Ingest ~500k customer transcripts, serve embeddings for semantic search with <100ms median retrieval latency.
- End-to-end app integration (on-prem connector) with no PHI leakage and audit logs for model calls.
- Cost target: average inference spend < $0.015 / 1k tokens for the steady-state workload.

Proposed evaluation plan (high level)
1) Week 0–1: Environment prep — infra access, service accounts, sample data slice (non-PHI).
2) Week 2–3: Model onboarding + baseline inference (functional QA).
3) Week 4: Scale test and latency/cost tuning.
4) Week 5–6: QA, security review, exec readout.

Draft RACI / stakeholder lanes (we'll refine):
- Infra (network, VPC peering, egress rules): Olive Labs infra team (you) — Redwood infra lead: Ben Carter (R), Soojin (C).
- App integration (SDK, client-side changes): Olive Apps — Redwood eng: Kimberly Park (A), Ben (C).
- Security & compliance (audit logs, data flow, KMS): Olive security — Redwood security contact: Marcus Lin (R).
- Procurement/contract (SLA addendum, DPA): Olive procurement — Redwood sales contact: Soojin (A).

Action items I propose (attachments included):
- Redwood: share PoC Action Grid (attached) + SOC2 evidence summary by EOD 10/18. [Attachment: PoC-Action-Grid.xlsx]
- Olive: confirm infra contact + provide sample data slice (anonymized) by 10/20.
- Both: schedule 30-min kickoff (narrow scope) — propose 10/21 10am PT.

Please reply with any corrections to the RACI lanes or timing. If that looks good I'll kick off the Doc + calendar invites.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
[Attachment: PoC-Action-Grid.xlsx]

From: John Miller <jm@olivelabs.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olive Labs POC <poc@olivelabs.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial check-in: stakeholder lanes + action grid for POC success

Hi Soojin —

This looks great and matches what we discussed. Quick clarifications from our side:
- Infra contact will be Mei Chen (meic@olivelabs.com) — she'll handle VPC peering and firewall rules.
- For security, our lead is Raj Patel (raj.patel@olivelabs.com); we'd like to see the list of logs Redwood can export (console + API).
- Procurement: we'll need an NDA update and a short addendum for data residency; procurement expects a draft by 10/25.

We'll provide an anonymized data slice by 10/20. 10/21 10am PT works for the kickoff.

Thanks,
John
Head of Platform | Olive Labs
jm@olivelabs.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: John Miller <jm@olivelabs.com>, Olive Labs POC <poc@olivelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T14:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial check-in: stakeholder lanes + action grid for POC success

John — thanks, that's helpful. I've updated the lanes below and added owners on the Redwood side. Please scan and confirm.

Updated RACI lanes (Redwood owners in parentheses):
- Infra (Olive: Mei Chen) — Redwood: Ben Carter (R), Soojin Lee (A). Tasks: VPC peering, static egress, subnet mapping. Due: 10/25.
- App integration (Olive apps team) — Redwood: Kimberly Park (A). Tasks: SDK drop, client config, end-to-end smoke. Due: Week 2 endpoint.
- Security & Compliance (Olive: Raj Patel) — Redwood: Marcus Lin (R). Tasks: list of exportable logs, KMS integration notes, SOC2 artifacts. Redwood to share Security-Evidence-Summary.pdf by EOD.
- Procurement / Legal — Redwood: Soojin Lee (A) to provide DPA/addendum template; Olive procurement to review by 10/25.

Concrete next steps:
- Redwood (Ben): initiate VPC peering playbook and send required IP blocks (by 10/20).
- Olive (Mei): confirm peering window and provide network engineer contact.
- Redwood (Kimberly): drop initial SDK + sample config into the shared drive (by 10/21).
- Redwood (Marcus): attach security artifact (will do now).

I've attached the PoC Action Grid and the security summary for your review.

On the kickoff: I've booked a 30-min slot for 10/21 10:00–10:30 PT and sent a calendar invite to the listed participants. If anyone else should be on that call (network or legal), please add them.

Cheers,
Soojin
[Attachment: Security-Evidence-Summary.pdf]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
